facts.quote: el evento comunitario de esta semana será de extrema velocidad, donde el ganador se lleva toda la carrera

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Evento Comunitario: Reto en el Circuito de Carreras de Torrentrueno)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event announcement for a player-versus-player kart race challenge at the Torrentrueno kart racing circuit, with server times for the Americas/Latin America and UK/Europe. It describes how to join the Karts Lobby and how to set up a PvP race (max players, AI disabled). The posting date is only given relative to capture ('4 months, 1 week ago'), so the event dates are the only dated anchors.
